title: Auth: get people out of in-app browsers

message.text: Proposal written, nothing built: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/25/spawned/mastermind-forms/inapp/proposal.md. Google sign-in is blocked in every in-app browser and there is no reliable escape, so: detect, show an 'open in your browser' card, and offer 'Send me a link' (a one-use link that brings back the draft). MVP is the detector and card, no backend. Needs one real-phone test of YouTube. Figma section 15 is being drawn.
